### I'm Going on The Meet Rack

### I'm Going on the Meet Locker

### Aftercare

Set yourself up for post-Rack recovery!

The Meet Rack relies on volunteer monitors to help us keep things flowing smoothly and safely. We wil have half-shifts so you can still enjoy the Meet Rack. Getting enough volunteers is one of the hardest part of running the event, Please consider helping!
